dedupe_keys.name: idb freight transport and logistics statistics yearbook 2012 2014 road rail air water transport and logistics indicators for 26 latin american and caribbean countries

description: The IDB Freight Transport and Logistics Statistics Yearbook was the Bank's first regional effort to collect and standardise freight sector data for its 26 borrowing member countries. Contents: indicators in seven groups (general indicators, roads, railways, air, water transport and logistics activities), each covering infrastructure (for example network length and port or airport facilities), fleet and activity (freight volumes and traffic), compiled from public sources and estimates. Producer: IDB Transport Division, which also runs a Logistics Observatory. Coverage: 26 countries of Latin America and the Caribbean, 2012 to 2014. Format and access: a dynamic Excel workbook with macros (XLSM, 0.9 MB) on IDB Open Data with a DOI; no registration. Licence: CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 IGO. Caveats: values mix official statistics with estimates, coverage varies by country and indicator, the series is not updated beyond 2014, and the file needs a spreadsheet program with macros for its filters. Simulation uses: calibrating modal split, network size and freight activity in regional freight and logistics models. Related records: the IDB container port efficiency scores (data-idb-lac-container-port-technical-efficiency-1999-2009) complement the port indicators.
